sloka: स शैलशृङ्गाभिहतो विसञ्ज्ञः पपात भूमौ युधि वानरेन्द्रः।तं प्रेक्ष्य भूमौ पतितं विसञ्ज्ञं नेदुः प्रहृष्टास्त्वथ यातुधानाः ।। ६.६७.६८ ।।
transliteration: sa śailaśṛṅgābhihato visañjñaḥ papāta bhūmau yudhi vānarendraḥ।taṁ prekṣya bhūmau patitaṁ visañjñaṁ neduḥ prahṛṣṭāstvatha yātudhānāḥ ।। 6.67.68 ।।

translations.english: That great soul, the Lord of Rakshasas seeing the pike broken in that way, was highly enraged. Taking Malaya Mountain from Lanka, he struck Sugriva who was approaching him.
